title: Gated Knowledge-Guided Prototype Transfer for Zero-Support Medical Vision Language Model
description: We introduce gated Knowledge-Guided Prototype Transfer (KGPT), a pre-repulsion module that transfers supported-class visual residuals to missing classes using VLM similarity and an ontology-based clinical distance. A validation-free evidence gate scales transfer based on semantic relevance and residual agreement, thereby limiting unsupported extrapolation.

paper.title: Gated Knowledge-Guided Prototype Transfer for Zero-Support Medical Vision Language Model

example_outputs.title: Default inputs
example_outputs.summary: Ungated transfer made a missing grade worse in 46–50% of support draws. The gate cut that to 16% and added +2.37 points of missing-class recall. Synthetic embeddings stand in for MESSIDOR with FLAIR features. SS-Text+ is approximated with a shrinkage-plus-repulsion prototype.

inputs.description: Your ordinal label list, mildest first, comma-separated (3–8 classes). The ontology is this order

inputs.label: Support counts
inputs.description: Labelled shots per class (same order). 0 = zero-support class. Paper: 3,1,1,0,0

inputs.label: Transfer strength β
inputs.description: Residual transfer strength (paper: 1). Gated KGPT uses β·g

inputs.label: Neighbours k
inputs.description: Top-k supported source classes per missing class (paper: 3)

inputs.label: Temperature
inputs.description: Softmax temperature; 0 = automatic T = max(std of scores, 1e−3) (paper)

inputs.label: Modality gap
inputs.description: Size of the image–text offset in the synthetic world (0 = none, 2 = large)

inputs.label: Separability
inputs.description: How far apart image clusters of adjacent grades are (0.5 = hard, 2 = easy)

inputs.label: Gap shrink per grade
inputs.description: How much less correction each higher grade needs. 0 = borrowed correction exactly right (ungated is safe)

inputs.label: World seed
inputs.description: Seed of the synthetic embedding world (test set and prototypes)
